notes: Printer Bot 3.0.4 lets you test every event from the dock with values you type: pick an event under Test print, change the name, the amount, the currency, the message or anything else it carries, and print it. YouTube Super Chats and memberships can now be tried as easily as a Twitch cheer, and your rules and High Roller decide with the values you typed. A receipt made from typed values says TEST at its bottom. A cheer no longer prints its cheermotes (Cheer100) as words, so a picture at the start of its message stays first. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, restart Streamer.bot and reload the dock. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.0.4 on GitHub.
